meta.title: Khang Hưng Tửu · Traditional rice and herbal wines from Long An since 1991
meta.description: Khang Hưng Tửu winery in Bến Lức, Long An: traditional Gò Đen rice wine, herbal wines, Central Highlands jar wine and steamed wine since 1991. Registered trademark. For adults 18+.

legal.age: Not for people under 18 or pregnant women.

topBar.orderOnly: Order only through the number printed on our cans: {phone}

hero.title: Khang Hưng Tửu
hero.text: From the famous Gò Đen rice-wine country of Bến Lức, Khang Hưng Tửu has steeped and crafted traditional rice and herbal wines since 1991, under its own registered trademark.
hero.imageAlt: The Khang Hưng Tửu showroom: large glass jars of steeped wine on wooden cabinets, with bottles and woven jugs below

since.title: Since 1991
since.text: More than thirty years of winemaking in Long An.

trademark.title: Registered trademark
trademark.text: An exclusive, registered brand: look for our label and seal.

quality.title: Own quality control
quality.text: Dedicated steeping rooms and an R&D and quality-control (KCS) lab.

partners.title: Partner with restaurants
partners.text: Display stands, cabinets and visits from our team, wherever you are.

featured.title: Tinh Dược Khang Hưng Tửu
featured.intro: Our best-known wines, in gift bottles and in the large cans that carry our one ordering number.

items.khangDuoc: Our flagship herbal wine in its signature red bottle.
items.ngocDuong: A classic herbal blend in a gourd-shaped bottle.
items.chuoiHot: Steeped with dried seeded bananas, a southern Vietnamese tradition.
items.canNgocDuong: Our Ngọc Dương blend, in a can for restaurants and families.
items.nepGoDen: Clear rice wine from Gò Đen glutinous rice, the pride of Long An.
items.hapNong: Wine made to be served warm (see how below).

jars.title: Steeped in glass, poured by the xị
jars.intro: Our steeping jars are on display at the showroom. Taste and buy by the xị at the company price, or take home a 5-litre bottle.
jars.imageAlt: Three 5-litre glass jars of Soái Dương Tửu, Minh Lăng Tửu and Xuân Trùng Thảo above matching red bottles

items.soaiDuong: Steeped herbal wine, in 5-litre jars and red bottles.
items.minhLang: Steeped herbal wine, in 5-litre jars and red bottles.
items.xuanTrungThao: Steeped herbal wine, in 5-litre jars and red bottles.

range.title: A rich and varied cellar
range.intro: Beyond the signature line, Khang Hưng Tửu offers a wide range for restaurants, gifts and family gatherings.
range.ingredientsNote: Each wine is steeped from its own blend of herbs. Ask us for the full ingredients of any product.

hapNong.title: Steamed wine (rượu hấp nóng)
hapNong.text: Our steamed wine is served warm. Two ways to heat it:
steps: Method 1: heat it in a double boiler.
Method 2: stand the bottle in boiling water for 5 minutes.
Once heated, pour and enjoy straight away: no mixing needed.

ruouCan.title: Central Highlands jar wine (rượu cần)
ruouCan.text: Jar wines in the styles of the Highlands' peoples, drunk through long bamboo straws. Add spring water to the jar before drinking.
ruouCan.imageAlt: Four woven jars of rượu cần in different ethnic styles

partners.title: Khang Hưng Tửu is delighted to partner with restaurants
partners.intro: We invest in, display and advertise our wines alongside you. Our staff will visit you in person to discuss every detail.

tower.title: Wine tower stand
tower.text: A wooden tower that showcases our bottles at your counter.
tower.imageAlt: Wooden wine tower stand with bottles

cabinet.title: Wine cabinet
cabinet.text: A display cabinet for your dining room.

about.title: Crafted in Long Hiệp, Bến Lức
about.text: Our winery sits on National Route 1A in the Gò Đen hamlet, home of one of Vietnam's best-known rice wines. Every batch is steeped in our own immersion rooms and checked by our research and quality-control lab before it leaves.
about.storefrontAlt: The Khang Hưng Tửu winery entrance on National Route 1A
about.factoryAlt: Steeping vats in the immersion department and shelves of samples in the R&D lab

counterfeit.title: Protect yourself from imitations
counterfeit.text: When ordering, please call the company directly. Our phone number is printed right on every can: {phone}. It is our only ordering number.

contact.title: Order or visit the winery
contact.text: Call or message us on Zalo to order. Restaurants and resellers are welcome: we'll come to you.
